research_updates.title: Current operator factsheet broadens the documented benefit account
research_updates.notes: Meta reports at least $750 million in cumulative data-center investment, at least 275 operational jobs supported and at least $6.4 million in direct funding to Rutherford County-area schools and nonprofits. It also says it pays the full cost of campus energy and town water/wastewater service. These statements remain operator-reported: the profile does not convert them into audited annual spending, direct FTEs, verified rate impacts or metered resource use.

source.title: Meta Forest City Data Center information sheet
source.notes: Undated current operator factsheet reviewed in 2026. It reports more than $750 million of North Carolina data-center investment, more than 275 operational jobs supported and more than $6.4 million of direct funding to Rutherford County-area schools and nonprofits. It also says Meta pays the full cost of campus energy and town water/wastewater service and describes water-efficiency design. These are operator claims, not audited employment, expenditure, rate-impact or metered-resource records.

research_updates.title: State record links a water-line grant to existing and planned jobs
research_updates.notes: The Rural Infrastructure Authority approved a $148,900 grant to the Town of Forest City for an approximately 1,000-foot publicly owned water-line extension serving a new Facebook campus building. The same record reports 100 existing positions and ten planned jobs over two years. The grant, existing-position snapshot and forecast remain separate; approval does not establish final expenditure or realized hiring.

source.title: North Carolina Rural Infrastructure Authority Approves Nearly $3.83 Million in Funding Requests
source.notes: The Rural Infrastructure Authority approval identifies a $148,900 Industrial Development Fund-Utility Account grant to the Town of Forest City for an approximately 1,000-foot publicly owned water-line extension serving a new Facebook campus building. It reports 100 existing positions and a plan for ten additional jobs over two years. The approval does not prove disbursement, final construction cost, realized hiring, worker residence or a complete public-cost account.

research_updates.title: Brownfield reuse adds community context
research_updates.notes: North Carolina DEQ identifies the data center as reuse of a former textile and boat-manufacturing site affected by contamination and vacancy, under a 2012 Brownfields Agreement. The agency's approximately 14% county-revenue statement is not encoded as a quantitative record because the current page gives no measurement date or denominator and the audited annual county series provides the more defensible fiscal evidence.

source.title: North Carolina Brownfields Program success stories - Andale Facebook Data Center
source.publisher: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality
source.notes: The state brownfields profile describes the former Burlington Industries and Tracker Marine site, contamination, vacancy after 2008 and redevelopment under a 2012 Brownfields Agreement. Its statement that Facebook represents approximately 14% of county revenue is retained only as context because the page gives no measurement date or denominator and does not reconcile the claim to the audited county fiscal series.

research_updates.title: Identity and opening chronology search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: operator facility and chronology. Query/identifier: Meta Forest City opening, Building 1, Building 2; date range 2010-2012. Documents inspected: Meta opening page and current Forest City factsheet. Result: useful - confirms operator, multi-building campus, November 2010 groundbreaking, April 19, 2012 Building 1 opening and planned 2012 Building 2; no building-to-inventory allocation was published.

source.title: Our Data Center Opens in Forest City, N.C.
source.notes: Meta reports that Building 1 broke ground in November 2010 and opened on April 19, 2012, while Building 2 was expected later in 2012. The page identifies a multi-building campus but does not allocate facts to the inventory building footprint.

research_updates.title: Brownfield land and boundary search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: state brownfields and land records. Query/identifier: Andale, project 14036-10-081, 1181/1185/1271/1291 Old Caroleen Road; date range 2010-2024. Documents inspected: 2012 Brownfields Annual Report, NCDEQ success story, finalized inventory and land-use-restriction update. Result: useful - former industrial use, contamination, agreement date and approximately 153-acre redevelopment boundary; no allocation to the selected building.

source.title: North Carolina Brownfields Program 2012 Annual Report - Andale
source.publisher: North Carolina Department of Environment and Natural Resources
source.notes: The Andale row identifies four Old Caroleen Road addresses, approximately 153 acres, former Burlington Industries use, VOC contamination, and planned data-center redevelopment under a February 3, 2012 brownfields agreement.

research_updates.title: Assessor parcel and ownership search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: county assessor/GIS. Query/identifier: UPPER(Property_Owner) LIKE '%ANDALE%' on EnerGov Parcel layer 3, with ParcelID, address, acreage, land, building and total-value fields. Date range: current snapshot queried September 6, 2026. Documents inspected: four returned parcel rows 54822, 54821, 54708 and 62150. Result: useful - 153.11 acres and $273,242,300 real-property value; negative for a dated assessment cycle, personal property, or a single-building allocation.

source.title: Rutherford County EnerGov parcel layer - ANDALE LLC query
source.notes: The exact owner query returned parcels 54822, 54821, 54708 and 62150 at 284 Social Circle, 0 Old Caroleen Road, 0 Social Circle and 408 Social Circle. source.title: Rutherford County, NC Annual Comprehensive Financial Report FY2025
source.notes: Note 13 is part of the financial-statement notes. Table 7 is a statistical table sourced to the county Revenue Department; it is not independently audited by this review. research_updates.title: Facility resource reporting search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: operator environmental data. Query/identifier: Forest City (NC) facility rows. Date range: calendar year 2024. Documents inspected: Meta 2025 Environmental Data Index electricity, water and Scope 2 tables/methodology. Result: useful - 535,555 MWh electricity, 16 ML water withdrawal and Scope 2 rows; negative for unrounded bills/meters, peak demand, IT load, consumption, reuse, discharge, cost and facility-specific PUE.

source.title: Meta 2025 Environmental Data Index
source.notes: Facility tables report Forest City electricity consumption of 535,555 MWh, water withdrawal of 16 megaliters, zero market-based Scope 2 emissions and 144,104 metric tons CO2e of location-based Scope 2 emissions for 2024. Values are rounded to whole displayed units and the methodology permits utility, meter, design-estimate or proxy inputs where applicable. Only electricity is normalized as a canonical source record because the shared evidence metric registry lacks compatible annual water-withdrawal and facility-emissions definitions.

research_updates.title: Utility and regulator search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: NCUC dockets/orders and Duke utility records. Exact queries/identifiers: Andale, Facebook Forest City, Forest City data center, OPT-H and interconnection; date range 2010-2026. Documents inspected: NCUC 2012 orders index/rate order, docket search portal and Duke site records. source.title: North Carolina Utilities Commission Orders and Decisions Issued in 2012

It provides no Forest City-specific load, demand, bill, tariff rider, interconnection cost, rate impact, or customer-level usage amount.

Documents inspected: Forest City water-treatment page, water/sewer overview, FY2023-FY2025 budgets/audit and 2025 system materials. research_updates.notes: Search family: NCDAQ permits/compliance. Exact identifiers: facility 8100221, permit 10165R03/10165R04, Andale, 284 Social Circle, generators; date range 2010-2026. Documents inspected: statewide permitted-facility inventory, compliance monitoring plan and indexed NCDEQ records. research_updates.title: State tax-exemption compliance search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: NCDOR statutes, exemption notices and rulings. Query/identifier: eligible internet datacenter, qualifying datacenter, electricity exemption, Facebook/Andale/Forest City. Date range: 2009-2026. Documents inspected: 2015 continuation notice, 2018 law changes, 2020 private-letter ruling, current statutes and July 23, 2026 repeal notice. Result: useful for program rules and repeal timing; negative for project identity, exempt purchase amount, forgone revenue, refund or compliance filing.

source.title: Important Notice: Repeal of Exemptions for Electricity Used at Datacenters
source.notes: The notice describes qualifying and eligible internet datacenter exemptions and the 2026 repeal of the electricity exemption. It does not identify Forest City or disclose taxpayer-level exempt purchases, forgone revenue, compliance filings, or refund amounts.

research_updates.title: Marginal public-service cost search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: county budgets, ACFRs and service departments. Query/identifier: Andale/Meta/Facebook plus fire, EMS, sheriff, infrastructure, tax administration and service cost. Date range: FY2021-FY2026. Documents inspected: Rutherford County ACFR series and FY2025-2026 budget message. Result: negative for a same-period, same-scope marginal annual county cost attributable to the project; the retained $319,124 model is therefore only a break-even threshold, not net fiscal benefit.

source.title: Rutherford County FY2025-2026 Budget Message
source.notes: The adopted-budget materials were reviewed for project-attributable public safety, infrastructure, tax-administration, water, or other service costs. No same-scope marginal annual cost for Meta/Andale was located.

research_updates.title: Community recipient search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: local schools, college and nonprofit recipients. Query/identifier: Meta/Facebook Forest City grant, XRAIL and Isothermal Community College. Date range: 2011-2026. Documents inspected: Isothermal's August 2024 XRAIL announcement and indexed Rutherford school/college pages. Result: useful - recipient-reported Meta grant above $250,000; negative for payment date, audited receipt and reconciliation to Meta's $6.4 million cumulative total.

source.title: Isothermal Community College partners with Meta to create high-tech lab
source.notes: The grant recipient reports a Meta grant of more than $250,000 for an Extended Reality and Artificial Intelligence Lab serving Polk and Rutherford counties and explicitly connects the partnership to Meta's Forest City Data Center community activity.

research_updates.title: Municipal audit and community grant search completed
research_updates.notes: Search family: municipal audited finance and community capital projects. Query/identifier: Meta Grant (BARN) and economic development incentive. Date range: FY2023-FY2025. Documents inspected: Town of Forest City FY2025 annual financial report and FY2023-FY2025 budgets. Result: useful - $300,000 Meta grant received in prior years and $5,070,136 total FY2025 incentive expense; negative for exact grant receipt year and named incentive recipient, so the latter is not assigned to Meta.

source.title: Town of Forest City Annual Financial Report for the Year Ended June 30, 2025
source.publisher: Town of Forest City, North Carolina
source.notes: The audited supplementary schedule reports a $300,000 Meta Grant (BARN), all received in prior years, for the Park Square Depot capital project. The report also shows a $5,070,136 FY2025 economic-development incentive expenditure but does not name its recipient, so that line is not encoded as a Meta record.

research_updates.title: County GDP comparison inputs rechecked
research_updates.notes: Search family: federal county economic data. Exact identifiers: BEA county real GDP series used in county-economic-core 2001-2024, Rutherford County FIPS 37161; date range 2001-2024. Documents inspected: BEA API guide and governed panel source rows/manifests. Result: useful for reproducible county aggregates and donor matching; negative for project-level output or causal attribution, so the retained comparison remains descriptive with fit sensitivity only.

source.title: BEA API for Data Retrieval User Guide
source.notes: The guide documents county GDP and income tables used by the governed 2001-2024 county panel. County aggregates do not identify Meta, isolate the campus, or establish a causal project effect.

research_updates.title: County employment and wage inputs rechecked
research_updates.notes: Search family: BLS QCEW county data. Exact identifiers: Rutherford County FIPS 37161, annual average employment and wage series in county-economic-core 2001-2024; date range 2001-2024. Documents inspected: QCEW searchable database/download guidance and governed panel source rows/manifests. Result: useful for county employment/wage comparisons; negative for named-establishment payroll or causal effect, so both retained gaps are labeled descriptive.

source.title: QCEW Searchable Databases
source.notes: The portal provides county employment and wage histories used by the governed comparison panel. Published county-industry aggregates do not disclose a Meta establishment payroll or support causal attribution to the Forest City campus.

research_updates.title: County industry and payroll alternative checked
research_updates.notes: Search family: Census County Business Patterns. Exact query: Rutherford County NC FIPS 37161, data processing/hosting industries, establishments, employment and payroll; date range 2010-2023. Documents inspected: CBP data and API portals. Result: negative for a disclosable Meta establishment payroll, project headcount, supplier purchases or worker residence because the statistics are county-industry aggregates and may be suppressed.

source.title: County Business Patterns Data
source.notes: County Business Patterns provides county-industry establishments, employment and payroll. Employer confidentiality and county aggregation prevent a project-specific Meta payroll, supplier-spend, or operating-headcount observation.

project_description: Meta's Forest City Data Center is a multi-building hyperscale campus operated by Meta in Rutherford County, North Carolina; the inventory project is one mapped building within that campus, while most public evidence is campus-wide and unallocated. Meta broke ground in November 2010, opened Building 1 on April 19, 2012, and expected Building 2 later in 2012 on the redeveloped Andale brownfield property. Contractor profiles describe two 370,000-square-foot buildings and a 789,000-square-foot campus program, and public records document later building work, four Andale-owned parcels, town water infrastructure, community grants, and facility-level resource reporting.
